A New With Tags example of Dolce & Gabbana's Martini Fit blazer in black stretch wool. The Martini line represents one of D&G's most enduring and recognizable silhouettes, a precisely tailored, Italian-made cut with a structured chest, suppressed waist, and clean lined finish that sits firmly within the house's formal tailoring tradition.

This piece was originally retailed as part of a complete suit at $2,395 USD and is offered here as the jacket only, unworn with original tags intact.

Constructed from a 98% wool / 2% spandex blend, the fabric delivers the weight and drape expected of Italian tailoring while offering a degree of comfort and mobility uncommon at this level. Details include peaked lapels with hand pick stitching, a chest welt pocket, front flap pockets, four-button functioning sleeve cuffs with gunmetal buttons, and a fully structured lined interior.
